text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, we've got the candles, so<n>next on the list
for this store is party<n>poppers, which should be
around...<n>there! Can you grab the five-pack?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is handling the prep for<n>Ritto Dorm's
holiday party, so I'm<n>tagging along to help with the
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hello? ...Sure, what is it? Oh, hmm. If I<n>had to pick a
spot for the tree, I think...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I think I'd want to have it centered in<n>the middle.
Try moving the shelf off to<n>the side, and see how
the tree looks<n>there! ...Yeah, sounds great! Bye!
choice_data_list: Hey, isn't it about time you took a break?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't just slack off. I've got to get<n>the
decorations set up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oh no, is it this late already?! No timeto talk—we need to get to the nextshop now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet! I wrapped up everything on<n>my end.
Anything I can help you with?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet! ♪ I'm all done with my<n>prep work for
Miho's party, so I'm<n>free to help too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! If I wasn't so<n>slow...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're not slow. We just finished our<n>tasks faster
than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I'm sorry to have left you<n>with so much
to do. Here, show me<n>what's left on the list.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... I think we should be able to<n>grab the rest in
town on the way back<n>to Tracen. I know a bunch of
local<n>stores from running student council<n>errands.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you only need a few more<n>ornaments for the
tree, we should still<n>have ten or so leftover at Miho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That'd be great. Is there anything<n>else on the list
we could borrow? It'd<n>be faster, not to mention
easier on the<n>dorm's budget.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As long as Scarlet's okay with it,<n>sounds like
we've got a plan, then!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: O-of course!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe I never even thought<n>of borrowing
things... Geez, I'm too<n>shortsighted!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... Thank you so, so much, Laurel!<n>C'mon, let's
get moving!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, that should be everything<n>on the list
accounted for. Before we<n>mosey, let's check—is
there anything<n>we're forgetting?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't think there is, but I'll...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: H-hang on... Wait, the wreath!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I almost forgot! They were sold out<n>before, so I was
going to try again<n>today, but then I completely forgot
to<n>put it on the list! Agh, I'm such an<n>idiot!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'm afraid there's not much<n>time. If we
don't start heading back<n>soon, we won't have time
to put up<n>all these decorations.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But we've got to have a wreath!There's still a little time, so I'll doeverything I can to find one quick!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in Ritto's been looking<n>forward to it. We
promised to take a<n>bunch of cute photos together
under<n>the wreath!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So... So I can't go back without one! I<n>swear I'll find
something!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Please bear with me! I want to make<n>the party
perfect—the way everyone<n>dreamed it'd be!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then let's split up and cover as many<n>stores as we
can.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, real quick before we split. What<n>about making a
wreath by hand?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...That could work! Then we'd 100%<n>have
something to put on the wall.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We've got all kinds of craft<n>supplies leftover
from Miho's<n>decorations, so use whatever you
need! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Should<n>we keep
searching for a proper<n>wreath, or hurry back and
make what<n>we can?
choice_data_list: We've still got time. Let's find a real gem!

A handmade one sounds like the safer bet. Let's
head back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's kind of what I was<n>thinking. Let's split
up and find the<n>perfect wreath!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Air Groove just messaged<n>us that she
found a wreath!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, you saw the message too?<n>I'm so glad!
Let's hurry back and get<n>decorating!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're going to help with that<n>too? Are you
sure?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's get so much done,<n>it'll blow Air
Groove's socks off<n>when she gets back with the
wreath!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! It'll be the best party<n>the dorm's
ever had!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Scarlet hurries over first<n>thing in the
morning to tell me how<n>perfectly the party went, a
massive<n>smile on her face!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I'm pretty good at crafts, so I<n>should be
fine making it myself.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I know you'll make the perfect wreath!
Yeah, I know you'll make the perfect wreath!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will! This'll be the best<n>party the dorm's
ever had!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Between this and the craft supplies<n>Laurel gave us,
I should definitely be<n>able to make something!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good. You focus on the wreath then.<n>I've got the
rest under control.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I swear, it'll be waybetter than the mass-produced ones!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Scarlet tells me how<n>perfectly the
party went—and lets me<n>see the beautiful wreath
she made!
